provenance: The manifest slug returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-15; the owner’s current public repository was found at the canonical transaction-parser-go slug.

discoveries: The README describes Raydium Launchpad/Bonkfun pre-migration and post-migration parsing and says parsers must inspect top-level and inner instructions; the README separately describes transaction sending.
hasGeyserMarkers() returns false, so ParseTransaction cannot enter its advertised Geyser branch; the dormant Geyser decoder also initializes empty instruction/account collections.

When standard transaction decoding fails, the active alternative decoder returns only a signature and empty event arrays; it does not report parse failure, so valid-but-unsupported transactions can be silently lost. A separate unreferenced demo fallback fabricates a sample swap and must not be used.
patterns: treat parse failure as unknown and never synthesize market observations

model creation, multiple trades, inner instructions, and migration as independent parsed events
sources.overlap: Potential parser-pattern reference only. SYLPH already has canonical ingress and Truth-X normalization; replacing them with this source would weaken trust because its Geyser path is unreachable and unsupported transactions can return empty-success results.
risks: The source README also describes transaction sending; do not run those tests or invoke any signing/submission path.
An unreferenced demonstration helper fabricates a sample swap from arbitrary long input.
No LICENSE file is present in the reviewed repository root; license remains unverified.
validation: Require an explicit parse status and fail closed on unsupported transaction versions or encodings.
